observation.command: cd /workspace && source /etc/profile.d/rvm-fnm.sh 2>/dev/null; echo "--- bin/rails -v ---"; timeout 60 bin/rails -v 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; echo "--- bin/rake -v ---"; timeout 60 bin/rake --version 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
